_golden: GOLDEN REFERENCE (arc hype: developer tools, AI, consumer apps, games, events). Study it, then write YOUR product's film from YOUR docs. Do not copy its lines, its numbers or its product. It is not buildable (no materials). Every _why says what a top crew did and why. Hype here means momentum, not shouting: short lines, real output, one number.
_facts: The docs this film was written from (fictional product): Relay, a command-line tool. Give it a failing test (the demo repository has 2,000 files); it shrinks the codebase to the smallest set of files that still fails. On our benchmark of 200 real bugs, the median reproduction was 3 files. Runs locally; your code is not uploaded. Works with pytest and Jest. Open source, MIT licence.

_anchors.proposition: A bug is easy to fix once you can see it alone.
_anchors.concept: Three files — the whole bug, small enough to read
_anchors.hook: One failing test. Two thousand files. Which three matter?
_anchors.last: Three files. Read them before lunch.
_anchors._why: A question the audience has asked themselves is the hook; the benchmark number is the hero's proof; the last line turns the number into the viewer's afternoon.
